name: Call Lightning

targets.description: each creature within 5 feet of a point under the storm cloud (a 60-foot-radius, 10-foot-tall Cylinder)

upcast.text: Cast outdoors in a storm, the spell controls that storm and its damage is 1d10 higher.

sustain.label: Call Lightning: bolt
sustain.help: A Magic action: call another bolt down on a point under the storm cloud.

summary: A storm cloud: call a bolt for 3d10 Lightning (Dex save, half) on creatures within 5 ft of a point, again each turn.
text: A storm cloud appears at a point you can see within range above you, a Cylinder 10 feet tall with a 60-foot radius. When you cast the spell, choose a point you can see under the cloud; a bolt strikes it, and each creature within 5 feet of that point makes a Dexterity saving throw, taking 3d10 Lightning damage on a failure or half as much on a success. Until the spell ends, you can take a Magic action to call down another bolt, at the same point or a different one. If you cast the spell outdoors in stormy weather, you take control of the existing storm instead of making a new cloud, and the spell's damage increases by 1d10. Concentration, up to 10 minutes. Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot: the damage increases by 1d10 for each slot level above 3.
